checkedAlternates.risk: A hub connects Ethernet ports like a switch.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A repeater hub broadcasts electrical signals at Layer 1 (group-4) without reading Layer 2 MAC addresses (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: A Layer-3 switch has "switch" in its name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Layer-3 switches perform IP packet routing at Layer 3 (group-2).
